messages:
eli_sales: Heads-up 1 Prospect NewBridge Pay (payment rails) sent a security questionnaire and requested a 72h POC. Requirements: SAML SSO (IdP & SP flows), SCIM bulk import + nightly deltas (target 60k users), RBAC with delegated admin roles and audit trail, domain locking (DNS TXT), EU data residency option, and a short Hosted vs Dedicated pricing comparison. They want a one-page SOW and an estimated dedicated commit range.
nina_se: noted. Do they want Hosted first or Dedicated for the latency validation?
eli_sales: they prefer Hosted for initial validation but asked for a costed migration path to Dedicated if perf looks good. Procurement asked for numbers by EOD.
omar_eng: sizing guidance: for 60k SCIM and ~120 TPS bursts recommend 5xGPU reserved cluster with 1.5x burst headroom. Committed spend range estimate: ~$35k-$80k/month depending on model family and quantization. Hosted POC for 72h (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen traffic) commonly <$1.2k usage.
omar_eng: perf note: suggest quantized variants + prefix KV caching and tuned batching to hit p95 targets; we'll include a cache warm-up window during the pilot.
nina_se: SCIM pattern: full import then nightly PATCH deltas. We'll send mapping example and a small staged import script. We can allow a temporary SCIM rate bump for the POC (2-3x normal cap) with guidance and monitored throttling.
zoe_sec: security checklist: request completed questionnaire, IdP metadata XML (entityID, ACS, X509 cert), SCIM ops needed (create/update/patch/delete), user data classification (PII/payment data?), retention/audit windows, and whether HSM is required. We'll provide SOC2 link, DPA template, pen-test summary, and our KMS/HSM options. Who will upload to their procurement portal?
eli_sales: I'll upload the security pack. Can someone drop a 1-paragraph security blurb and a 1-paragraph pricing summary I can paste into procurement email? Need by EOD.
zoe_sec: security blurb: "SOC2 Type II in place; DPA template available; redacted pen-test summary and encryption-at-rest + in-transit details attached. EU region tenancy supported for data residency; managed KMS by default with enterprise HSM options. Audit logs retained per plan; extended retention available for Dedicated customers."
omar_eng: pricing paragraph: "Hosted: pay-as-you-go usage billing, quick to spin up for evaluations and light production; typical 72h POC (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) expected under $1.2k. Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and latency SLAs; for a 5-GPU cluster sized for 120 TPS bursts expect a committed range roughly $35k-$80k/month depending on model family and quantization. One-time POC support (eng + security) can be covered by pilot credits or invoiced as professional services."
ben_legal: I'll standby for DPA countersign; please forward their legal POC contact.
eli_sales: action items: (1) Ask NewBridge for IdP metadata and a 100-user CSV sample, (2) Upload security pack (Zoe), (3) Omar to own infra/perf smoke if needed, (4) Nina to own SCIM mapping and integration.
poc_bot: ticket #POC-9234 created: NewBridge Pay POC 1 owners: omar_eng (infra), nina_se (integration), zoe_sec (security). Link: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-9234
eli_sales: I'll send initial ask to NewBridge now. Please keep replies and updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
